questions.q: Who is the fastest of Rani, Supriya and Amita (all different)? I. Rani and Supriya take 5 days; Supriya and Amita take 10 days. II. Rani and Amita take 30/7 days.
questions.why: From I, r − a = 1/10, so Rani beats Amita. Since s + a = 1/10, s is below 1/10 while r is above it, so Rani is fastest. GPSC CBRT, Feb 2024.

questions.q: In a group of 60 people, 27 like Hindi, 32 like English and 4 like neither. How many like only Hindi?
questions.why: Both = 27 + 32 − (60 − 4) = 3; only Hindi = 27 − 3 = 24. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: In an x m race, Chaupat beats Popat by 18 m and Sarpat by 24 m; Popat beats Sarpat by 8 m. Find x.
questions.why: (x − 24)/(x − 18) = (x − 8)/x gives 2x = 144, so x = 72. GPSC CBRT, Nov 2023.

questions.q: The banker's gain on a sum due 2 years hence at 10% a year is ₹24. What is the present worth?
questions.why: BG = TD × RT/100, so TD = 24 × 100 ÷ 20 = 120; PW = TD × 100 ÷ RT = 600. GPSC CBRT, Apr 2024.

questions.q: The present ages of Ravi and Anil are in the ratio 6 : 2. After 3 years the ratio will be 51 : 19. What is Anil's present age?
questions.why: Let the ages be 6k and 2k: (6k + 3)/(2k + 3) = 51/19 gives k = 8, so Anil is 16. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: A hostel mess requires 60 kg of rice every day except every 7th day, on which only 50 kg is required. How many kg of rice is required for 150 days starting from the first day?
questions.why: 150 ÷ 7 gives 21 lighter days. 150 × 60 − 21 × 10 = 8790. GPSC CBRT, Nov 2023.

questions.q: Sita walks 7 m South, then turns right and walks 9 m, then turns left and walks 4 m, then turns left and walks 6 m. Which direction is Sita facing now?
questions.why: Follow each turn from the first direction: the last leg is towards the East. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: In how many different ways can the letters of the word BANANA be arranged?
questions.why: 6 letters with repeats: 6! ÷ 3! ÷ 2! = 60. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: The present ages of Ravi and Rahul are in the ratio 6 : 5. After 8 years the ratio will be 38 : 33. What is Rahul's present age?
questions.why: Let the ages be 6k and 5k: (6k + 8)/(5k + 8) = 38/33 gives k = 5, so Rahul is 25. GPSC-style practice item.
Middle digit = first − last (8 − 5 = 3 …); for 751, 7 − 1 = 6, not 5. GPSC CBRT, Dec 2024.
